title: IT Services Franchise Opportunity
tagline: Indian IT services company headquartered in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, offering coding and software development services. - The company has built a strong local brand and is expanding internationally through franchise partners. - The franchise model is designed for international partners, primarily in the US and UK, to represent the brand and develop local business on a profit-sharing basis. - The financial commitment is flexible and can be structured based on the partner's approach and business model. - Franchise partners receive comprehensive support from the company to establish and grow operations in their respective markets. - The company has completed 100+ software projects for clients across Japan, China and the US. - Currently serves 10+ clients across its international markets. - The company is looking to onboard 1–2 committed franchise partners initially for international expansion. - The business is incorporated with the MCA and has been operating for approximately 8 years.
